policy_name: Panniculectomy and Removal of Excess/Redundant Skin

conditions.description: Pannus is a grade II or higher as documented by clinical notes and/or pre-operative notes
Pannus is documented to have caused recurrent chronic rashes, infections, cellulitis, or non-healing ulcers under the panniculus
Documentation of a minimum of a 3-month trial and failure of treatment with prescribed systemic oral or IV antibiotics
Pannus is documented to cause significant functional impairment to activities of daily living with panniculectomy expected to restore or improve function
Documentation of a stable weight for at least 6 months
Pannus is a grade II or higher as documented by clinical notes and/or pre-operative notes
Pannus is documented to have caused recurrent chronic rashes, infections, cellulitis, or non-healing ulcers under the panniculus
Documentation of a minimum of a 3-month trial and failure of treatment with prescribed systemic oral or IV antibiotics
Pannus is documented to cause significant functional impairment to activities of daily living with panniculectomy expected to restore or improve function
In cases where a bariatric surgery was performed the patient must be 18 months post op
12 months of documented stabilization of weight
BMI < 35
Performed in conjunction with abdominal or gynecological procedures
Documented that the panniculectomy will reduce excessive skin tension that may impair wound healing

exclusions.description: Treatment for neck or back pain
Minimizing risk for hernia formation or recurrence
Repairing abdominal wall laxity or diastasis recti
Suction assisted lipectomy performed alone or not as a part of a medically necessary panniculectomy procedure
Current nicotine/tobacco use unless actively enrolled in a tobacco cessation program with a commitment to be nicotine/tobacco-free for a minimum of 30-days prior to surgery
Diabetes with poorly controlled blood sugar as evidenced by an HbA1c > 7.5

documentation_requirements.requirement: Last 6 months of clinical notes from requesting provider &/or specialist
